blocks.text: Magnetic quantum number ‘m’ batata hai ke orbital space mein kis taraf (orientation) hai. Kisi subshell mein m ki qeematein ℓ par depend karti hain. Har ℓ ke liye m ki (2ℓ + 1) whole number qeematein hain:

m ki jitni qeematein, subshell mein utne orbitals. ℓ = 0 (s-subshell) ho to m ki sirf ek qeemat 0 hai, yani s-subshell mein sirf 1 orbital. ℓ = 1 (p-subshell) ho to m ki teen qeematein −1, 0 aur +1 hain, yani p-subshell mein teen orbitals.

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain?
blocks.text: Magnetic field mein spectral lines bareek lines mein toot jati hain (splitting). Yeh, aur space mein un ka three-dimensional rukh, batata hai ke subshells mein orbitals maujood hain.
ℓ = 2 (d-subshell) ho to m ki paanch qeematein −2, −1, 0, +1 aur +2 hain, yani d-subshell mein 5 orbitals.
ℓ = 3 (f-subshell) ho to m ki saat qeematein −3, −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3 hain, yani f-subshell mein 7 orbitals.

Ek hi subshell ke orbitals ki energy barabar hoti hai; inhen degenerate orbitals (barabar energy wale orbitals) kehte hain. Magnetic field mein yeh ek doosre se alag pehchane jate hain, isi liye is quantum number ka naam magnetic quantum number hai. ℓ aur m ka rishta Table 2.5 mein hai.

blocks.caption: Table 2.5 ℓ aur m ka rishta

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: orbitals ki tadaad = 2ℓ + 1. s = 1, p = 3, d = 5, f = 7. Har orbital mein 2 electrons, is liye s = 2, p = 6, d = 10, f = 14 electrons.

items: m orientation batata hai; −ℓ se +ℓ tak, yani subshell mein 2ℓ + 1 orbitals: s 1, p 3, d 5, f 7.
Ek subshell ke orbitals degenerate (barabar energy) hain; magnetic field mein alag hote hain.
